en: The front side of the postcard displays a sepia-toned photograph of a formal garden, featuring a central fountain, symmetrical flower beds with blooming shrubs, decorative benches, tall manicured hedges, and classic garden urns. The scene is tranquil and represents a well-maintained public garden. At the bottom, the text reads: 'Bad Pyrmont. Palmengarten. Verlobungslaube.' The reverse side contains handwritten German text, a postage stamp of the Deutsches Reich, and postal markings. Printed text and a museum stamp are present as well.
